newsitem.title: INDIA: Mild earthquake rocks north India.
newsitem.headline: Mild earthquake rocks north India.

text.p: A mild earthquake rocked Srinagar, the summer capital of India's Jammu and Kashmir state, on Wednesday but there were no reports of injuries or damage, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.
PTI said the tremor was felt around 11.10 a.m. (0535 GMT). It did not give details. Seismology officials could not be immediately reached for further details.
In 1993, a quake of 6.4 on the Richter scale devastated a large area of neighbouring Maharashtra state, killing more than 11,000 people, and leaving about 150,000 homeless.
